recentItems.description:
Ravi Mohan gets candid and hilarious at the Sardar 2 Audio & Trailer Launch! 🔥

In this fun-filled interaction, Ravi Mohan plays a hilarious Spy Mission game involving his close friends Karthi, Arya, Vishal and Jiiva. He reveals who would make the perfect spy, who would accidentally expose the mission, who would get caught undercover and who would come running to help if someone gets caught by the police!

Ravi Mohan also shares his immense admiration and love for Karthi, recalling their friendship, Karthi’s support during Ponniyin Selvan, and the valuable lessons he learned from Suriya.

He also praises the Sardar 2 trailer, director P. S. Mithran, Dileep Master and the entire team, while expressing his excitement for the film's release.

Watch the full interaction for fun moments, friendship, emotional memories and Ravi Mohan's special words about Karthi! ❤️🔥
